description: This Java class 'SendingContext' encapsulates context information for publishing a message to a generic target within the Eclipse Ditto project, including details about signals, messages, targets, and monitoring.

classes.name: SendingContext
classes.description: Encapsulates context information for sending messages, including signal, message, target, and monitoring details.

classes.name: SendingContext.Builder
classes.description: Fluent builder class for constructing instances of SendingContext.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for SendingContext.

methods.name: getPublishedMonitor
methods.description: Returns the monitor for published messages.

methods.name: getAcknowledgedMonitor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the acknowledged monitor, if any.

methods.name: getDroppedMonitor
methods.description: Returns the monitor for dropped messages.

methods.name: getAutoAckTarget
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the auto-acknowledgment target, if any.

methods.name: shouldAcknowledge
methods.description: Determines if acknowledgment is required based on autoAckTarget and acknowledgedMonitor.

methods.name: setExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns a new SendingContext with the specified external message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a SendingContext instance from the builder.

methods.name: mappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Sets the mapped outbound signal in the builder.

methods.name: externalMessage
methods.description: Sets the external message in the builder.

methods.name: genericTarget
methods.description: Sets the generic target in the builder.

methods.name: publishedMonitor
methods.description: Sets the published monitor in the builder.

methods.name: acknowledgedMonitor
methods.description: Sets the acknowledged monitor in the builder.

methods.name: droppedMonitor
methods.description: Sets the dropped monitor in the builder.

methods.name: autoAckTarget
methods.description: Sets the auto-acknowledgment target in the builder.
